correctness.rationale: For positive a,b,c, the cyclic three-hat Gram matrix is G=(1/6)[[2(a+c),a,c],[a,2(a+b),b],[c,b,2(b+c)]]. The reproducing kernel K(x,y) is affine in evaluation x within each arc; convexity of ∫|K(x,y)|dy reduces the L∞ norm to three knots. Its knot-0 inverse row (A,−X,−Y)/D is verified by direct symbolic inversion, and ∫K=1 makes the norm 1+2 times its negative area Q. The proof exhausts X,Y≥0, X<0, Y<0; X,Y cannot both be negative. The displayed exact positive-coefficient polynomials R,T prove 2/3−Q>0 in the first and second regimes, with the third by symmetry. Independent SymPy algebra verified inverse identities and positive-denominator formulations; the degeneration (a,b,c)=(ε²,1,ε) has Q→2/3 exactly, while a=b=c yields 16/9. This proves a strict per-mesh norm <7/3 and unattained global supremum 7/3; no reliance on finite samples.
